image.title: Plat of Medora, Billings County, D.T., 1883
image.repository: State Historical Society of North Dakota, Marquis de Mores Collection 00042, item 00042-00183

control_points_note: Pixel coordinates are on the 469x525 SHSND web image. Ground coordinates are PLSS section corners from the ND GIS Hub PLSS Sections layer (T140N R102W, 5th PM): corner of Secs 22/23/26/27, corner of Secs 26/27/34/35, and the north quarter corner of Sec 27 (midpoint of the 21/22/27/28 and 22/23/26/27 corners). The plat marks section corners with circled crosses and draws section and quarter lines.
fit_note: Three-point affine (exact fit). Check: the modern Northern Pacific/BNSF track and the modern Block 15 parcels (Von Hoffman House) fall on the plat's track and north grid within a few pixels (~15 m).
